verdicts.reason: Both lose the cream circle behind the can and push it into the bottom-left corner as a stray blob. That leaves the product as a faint outline that sinks into the orange background. Both also mix a left-aligned headline and 'Out now.' with a centred can and CTA, and the headline is undersized for a square. A puts the can above the headline, so the eye starts on a weak, washed-out graphic, and it leaves a large empty band at the top. B leads with the headline and has slightly more even vertical rhythm, but the copy is cut off from the product by dead space and the same broken circle remains.
